idNote.en: Braided-trunk standard; blooms red on the porch.
idNote.zh: 编成辫子的树形扶桑，在阳台上开红花。

light.en: Full sun to bright part sun, 6+ hours
light.zh: 全日照到明亮半日照，每天 6 小时以上

water.en: Keep evenly moist; container dries fast in summer heat
water.zh: 保持土壤均匀湿润；夏天盆栽干得很快

catNote.en: ASPCA lists hibiscus (Rose of China) as non-toxic to cats.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定朱槿（扶桑）对猫无毒。

note.en: Each bloom lasts about a day; bring indoors before fall frost in the Northeast.
note.zh: 每朵花只开一天左右；入秋降霜前要搬回室内。

humidity.en: High (60%+); browns at edges in dry air
humidity.zh: 高湿度（60% 以上），空气太干叶尖会发黄

light.en: Bright indirect light; avoid harsh direct sun
light.zh: 明亮散射光，避免强烈直射

water.en: Keep consistently moist; water when top 2-3 cm dry
water.zh: 保持微湿；表土 2-3 厘米干了就浇

catNote.en: Toxic to cats per ASPCA (sapogenins); berries cause GI upset, contact dermatitis
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定文竹对猫有毒（皂苷）；浆果会引起肠胃不适。

note.en: Not a true fern, it's an asparagus relative with tiny hidden thorns on mature stems
note.zh: 其实不是真蕨类，而是天门冬的亲戚，成熟茎上藏着小刺。

idNote.en: Fuzzy-edged rosette; exact species uncertain.
idNote.zh: 毛边小莲座，具体种类待定。

humidity.zh: 低湿度，干燥空气没问题

light.en: Full sun to bright light

water.en: Drench when soil is fully dry; barely in winter
water.zh: 土完全干透再浇透；冬天几乎不浇

catNote.en: Non-toxic to cats per ASPCA.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定长生草对猫无毒。

note.en: Each rosette dies after flowering, but its 'chicks' carry on.
note.zh: 每个莲座开花后会功成身退，但“小鸡”们会接班。

idNote.en: Sending up a flower stalk!
idNote.zh: 正在抽花剑！

light.en: Bright light with some direct sun

water.en: Soak when dry; much less in winter
water.zh: 干透浇透；冬天大幅减少

catNote.en: Not on the ASPCA list - a jade relative, so best kept from nibblers.
catNote.zh: 不在 ASPCA 名录上——玉树近亲，最好别让猫啃。

note.en: Leaves snap off easily and can root into whole new plants.
note.zh: 叶子一碰就掉，但掉下的叶子能长成新株。

idNote.en: Red-toothed hybrid aloe; 'Christmas Carol' is our best match.
idNote.zh: 红齿杂交芦荟，“圣诞颂歌”是我们最接近的猜测。

humidity.en: Low - average room air is fine
humidity.zh: 低湿度，普通室内空气即可

light.en: Bright light; sun deepens the red color
light.zh: 明亮光线；晒太阳会更红

water.en: Water deeply only when soil is fully dry
water.zh: 土完全干透才浇透

catNote.en: Aloes are toxic to cats per ASPCA (vomiting, lethargy).
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定芦荟对猫有毒（呕吐、嗜睡）。

note.en: Sun stress and cool nights turn it ruby red.
note.zh: 日晒加凉爽的夜晚会把它晒成宝石红。

humidity.en: Moderate; tolerates ~45% if soil stays moist
humidity.zh: 中等湿度；土保持湿润可耐 45% 左右

light.en: Bright indirect light to part shade

water.en: Keep soil evenly moist, not soggy
water.zh: 保持土壤均匀湿润但不积水

catNote.en: Non-toxic to cats per ASPCA (Pilea microphylla listed as safe)
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定小叶冷水花对猫无毒。

note.en: Named for flowers that explosively fire pollen in little puffs when touched
note.zh: 名字来自它的花——轻轻一碰就“开炮”喷出花粉。

light.en: As much direct sun as possible

water.en: Very sparingly; none while splitting or in winter
water.zh: 极少量；蜕皮期和冬天完全断水

catNote.en: Mesembs are generally non-toxic to cats.
catNote.zh: 番杏科多肉一般对猫无毒。

note.en: Overwatering makes it burst - it should hold only one leaf pair at a time.
note.zh: 浇多了会撑裂——同一时间只该保留一对叶子。

light.en: Bright sun on a windowsill

water.en: Lightly in spring/fall; keep dry in summer heat and winter
water.zh: 春秋少量；盛夏和冬天保持干燥

catNote.en: Non-toxic to cats (mesemb family, generally pet-safe).
catNote.zh: 对猫无毒（番杏科，一般对宠物安全）。

note.en: In habitat it grows buried, with only its clear leaf 'windows' above the sand.
note.zh: 原生地整株埋在沙里，只露出透明的叶窗。

light.en: Bright indirect; tolerates less sun than most succulents
light.zh: 明亮散射光；比大多数多肉更耐阴

water.en: When fully dry, roughly every 2-3 weeks
water.zh: 完全干透再浇，大约两三周一次

catNote.en: Haworthia are non-toxic to cats per ASPCA.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定瓦苇（十二卷）类对猫无毒。

note.en: One of the best succulents for windows without full sun.
note.zh: 不需要全日照窗台的多肉里，它是最好养的之一。

light.en: Bright indirect light; tolerates some shade

water.en: Soak when dry; sparingly in winter
water.zh: 干透浇透；冬天少浇

catNote.en: Gasteria are commonly listed as pet-safe (non-toxic).
catNote.zh: 沙鱼掌一般被认为对宠物安全（无毒）。

note.en: Named for its little stomach-shaped flowers.
note.zh: 属名来自它胃袋形状的小花。

humidity.en: Average home humidity fine; a bit extra keeps tips green
humidity.zh: 普通室内湿度即可，稍高些叶尖更绿

light.en: Bright indirect; purple stripes fade in low light
light.zh: 明亮散射光；光线不足紫纹会变淡

water.en: Let top 2-3 cm dry between waterings
water.zh: 表土 2-3 厘米干了再浇

catNote.en: Toxic to cats per ASPCA inch plant listing; sap causes dermatitis and GI upset
catNote.zh: ASPCA 列为对猫有毒；汁液会引起皮炎和肠胃不适。

note.en: Grows an inch at a time; pinch stem tips often to keep it bushy instead of leggy
note.zh: 勤掐尖才长得丰满，不然容易徒长。

humidity.en: Average; thrives in warm humid summers
humidity.zh: 普通湿度；喜温暖湿润的夏天

light.en: Full sun

water.en: Evenly moist; tolerates brief dry spells
water.zh: 保持均匀湿润；短暂干旱也能扛

catNote.en: Not on ASPCA lists but widely reported non-toxic to cats, dogs, and people.
catNote.zh: 不在 ASPCA 名录，但普遍认为对猫狗无毒。

note.en: Star-shaped flower clusters are butterfly favorites; deadhead to keep blooms coming all season.
note.zh: 星形花簇是蝴蝶最爱；勤剪残花能一直开到秋天。

light.en: Full sun to bright light

water.en: Soak-and-dry in summer; nearly dry in winter
water.zh: 夏天干透浇透；冬天几乎断水

catNote.en: Not known to be toxic to cats.
catNote.zh: 未见对猫有毒的记录。

note.en: The 'teeth' are soft - in habitat they help collect fog moisture.
note.zh: 那些“牙齿”是软的——原生地用来收集雾气。

idNote.en: Knobby stems with tiny leaf tufts; could also be a corncob euphorbia.
idNote.zh: 疙瘩状的茎带小叶簇；也可能是某种玉米棒大戟。

light.en: Full sun

water.en: Water when fully dry; roughly monthly
water.zh: 完全干透再浇，约一个月一次

catNote.en: Not toxic to cats, but the spines are a real physical hazard.
catNote.zh: 对猫无毒，但尖刺是实打实的物理伤害。

note.en: In the Andes it grows into a four-meter tree.
note.zh: 在安第斯山脉能长成四米高的树。

idNote.en: Smooth paired 'fingers' - our best guess is a Cheiridopsis.
idNote.zh: 光滑成对的“手指”——我们最接近的猜测是虾钳花属。

light.en: Bright sun

water.en: Winter grower: water fall-spring, keep mostly dry in summer
water.zh: 冬型种：秋到春浇水，夏天基本断水

catNote.en: Mesembs are generally pet-safe, but our ID is uncertain.
catNote.zh: 番杏科一般对宠物安全，但品种鉴定还不确定。

note.en: A South African winter grower - its seasons run opposite ours.
note.zh: 南非的冬型多肉——它的季节和我们是反的。

idNote.en: Nursery label reads 'Crassula perforata variegata'.
idNote.zh: 苗圃标签写着“Crassula perforata variegata”。

light.en: Bright light with some direct sun

water.en: Soak when dry; eases off in midsummer
water.zh: 干透浇透；盛夏放缓

catNote.en: Crassula (jade family) are toxic to cats per ASPCA.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定青锁龙属（玉树近亲）对猫有毒。

note.en: The stems look threaded straight through the stacked leaves.
note.zh: 茎像是从一串叠起的叶子中间穿过去的。

light.en: Bright light to full sun

water.en: Water when dry spring-fall; sparingly in winter
water.zh: 春到秋干了就浇；冬天少量

catNote.en: Euphorbia sap is toxic and irritating to cats per ASPCA.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定大戟属汁液对猫有毒且有刺激性。

note.en: The milky sap irritates human skin too - gloves on for repotting.
note.zh: 乳白汁液对人的皮肤也有刺激——换盆记得戴手套。

idNote.en: Flower spikes drying - seeds incoming?
idNote.zh: 花穗正在干枯——是要结种子了吗？

light.en: Full sun to part shade, 6+ hours best
light.zh: 全日照到半阴，最好 6 小时以上

water.en: Water when soil dries a few inches down; drought tolerant once established
water.zh: 土干下去几厘米再浇；成株耐旱

catNote.en: Not on the ASPCA toxic list; widely regarded as non-toxic to cats.
catNote.zh: 不在 ASPCA 有毒名录，普遍认为对猫无毒。

note.en: Licorice-scented leaves make good tea, and blooms are a bee and hummingbird magnet.
note.zh: 叶子有甘草香，能泡茶；花是蜜蜂和蜂鸟的磁铁。

idNote.en: Came with its own COLEUS tag.
idNote.zh: 自带“COLEUS”标签。

light.en: Part shade to bright indirect; morning sun is ideal
light.zh: 半阴到明亮散射光；晨光最理想

water.en: Keep evenly moist; water when top inch feels dry
water.zh: 保持均匀湿润；表土一寸干了就浇

catNote.en: ASPCA lists coleus as toxic to cats; essential oils cause vomiting and diarrhea.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定彩叶草对猫有毒；精油会引起呕吐腹泻。

note.en: Pinch off flower spikes so energy goes into its vividly colored foliage.
note.zh: 掐掉花穗，让养分都留给五彩的叶子。

humidity.en: Prefers dry air with good airflow

light.en: Full sun, 6+ hours

water.en: Water when top inch is dry; never let pot sit in water
water.zh: 表土一寸干了再浇；切忌盆内积水

catNote.en: ASPCA lists rosemary as non-toxic to cats.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定迷迭香对猫无毒。

note.en: Overwatering is the top killer of potted rosemary; sharp drainage is essential.
note.zh: 盆栽迷迭香的头号死因是浇太多，排水一定要好。

idNote.en: Pinnate baby leaves - best guess is a tamarind sprouted from seed.
idNote.zh: 羽状小叶——我们猜是种子发芽的罗望子（酸角）。

humidity.en: High, 60%+; mist or use a humidifier

light.en: Bright direct sun; south window, 6+ hours
light.zh: 明亮直射光；南窗 6 小时以上

water.en: Keep seedling evenly moist; later water when top 1-2 inches dry
water.zh: 苗期保持均匀湿润；之后表土干了再浇

catNote.en: Not on the ASPCA toxic list; tamarind is generally considered non-toxic to cats.
catNote.zh: 不在 ASPCA 有毒名录；罗望子一般认为对猫无毒。

note.en: Soak seeds 12-24 hours before sowing; keep it warm (70-80F) away from cold drafts.
note.zh: 罗望子播种前要泡 12-24 小时；保持温暖，远离冷风。

light.en: Full sun, 6-8 hours; won't bloom in shade
light.zh: 全日照 6-8 小时；背阴不开花

water.en: Drought tolerant; one deep watering a week in summer
water.zh: 很耐旱；盛夏一周浇透一次

catNote.en: ASPCA lists moss rose (Portulaca) as toxic to cats via soluble calcium oxalates.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定马齿苋对猫有毒（可溶性草酸盐）。

note.en: Succulent leaves store water, and flowers close at night and on cloudy days.
note.zh: 肉质叶片会储水，花朵夜里和阴天会合上。

idNote.en: Rooting in water - likely a pup of the big curly spider plant.
idNote.zh: 正在水培生根——多半是大卷叶吊兰的小崽。

light.en: Medium to bright indirect; avoid direct midday sun
light.zh: 中等到明亮散射光，避开正午直射

water.en: Let top 2-5 cm dry between waterings
water.zh: 表土干 2-5 厘米再浇

catNote.en: Non-toxic to cats per ASPCA, though cats love chewing it and may get mild GI upset
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定吊兰对猫无毒，但猫爱嚼，吃多了会轻微闹肚子。

note.en: Fluoride in tap water causes brown tips; 'Bonnie' has fun curly leaves and makes babies
note.zh: 自来水里的氟会让叶尖发焦；“Bonnie”卷叶还会生小崽。

humidity.zh: 中等湿度；避免干燥的风口

light.en: 6+ hours of bright indirect light
light.zh: 每天 6 小时以上明亮散射光

water.en: When top inch dries; drain the foil sleeve
water.zh: 表土一寸干了再浇；套盆里别积水

catNote.en: Mildly toxic per ASPCA; sap irritates mouth and stomach, though its danger is often overrated.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定轻微有毒；汁液刺激口腔和肠胃，但危险性常被夸大。

note.en: Needs about 14 hours of total darkness nightly for 8 weeks in fall to re-color its bracts.
note.zh: 秋起每晚约 14 小时完全黑暗、持续 8 周，苞片才会重新变红。

name.zh: 脑状仙人掌（金手指缀化）

light.en: Bright direct light, 4+ hours daily
light.zh: 每天 4 小时以上明亮直射光

water.en: Soak and dry; barely water in winter
water.zh: 干透浇透；冬天几乎不浇

catNote.en: Not on ASPCA toxic list; Mammillaria cacti are non-toxic, though spines pose a poke hazard.
catNote.zh: 不在 ASPCA 有毒名录；乳突球属无毒，但刺会扎。

note.en: Its folded brain shape comes from a rare crested mutation of the ladyfinger cactus.
note.zh: 大脑般的褶皱来自金手指仙人掌罕见的缀化变异。

humidity.en: High; most homes too dry, use humidifier or pebble tray
humidity.zh: 高湿度；多数家里太干，需要加湿器或垫石盘

light.en: Bright filtered/indirect light; direct sun burns fronds
light.zh: 明亮的过滤光；直射会烧叶

water.en: Keep soil evenly moist; water when surface starts to dry
water.zh: 保持土壤均匀湿润；表面刚开始干就浇

catNote.en: Non-toxic to cats per ASPCA (a true fern, safe to nibble)
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定波士顿蕨对猫无毒（真蕨类，啃了也没事）。

note.en: Sheds and browns in dry winter air; regular misting or a bathroom spot keeps it lush
note.zh: 冬天空气干会掉叶发黄；常喷雾或挪到浴室就能翠绿。

idNote.en: Survived the holidays and thriving.
idNote.zh: 熬过了节日季还越长越旺。

humidity.zh: 中等湿度；避免干燥的风口

light.en: 6+ hours of bright indirect light
light.zh: 每天 6 小时以上明亮散射光

water.en: When top inch dries; drain the foil sleeve
water.zh: 表土一寸干了再浇；套盆里别积水

catNote.en: Mildly toxic per ASPCA; sap irritates mouth and stomach, though its danger is often overrated.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定轻微有毒；汁液刺激口腔和肠胃，但危险性常被夸大。

note.en: Needs about 14 hours of total darkness nightly for 8 weeks in fall to re-color its bracts.
note.zh: 秋起每晚约 14 小时完全黑暗、持续 8 周，苞片才会重新变红。

idNote.en: Looking crispy on the porch - fingers crossed.
idNote.zh: 在阳台上晒得有点干脆——祈祷它挺住。

humidity.en: Needs dry air; dislikes humid, stagnant spots

light.en: Full sun, 6-8 hours

water.en: Sparingly; let soil dry out, hates wet feet
water.zh: 少浇；土干透再浇，最怕烂根

catNote.en: ASPCA lists lavender as toxic to cats; linalool causes nausea and vomiting.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定薰衣草对猫有毒；芳樟醇会引起恶心呕吐。

note.en: Use lean gritty mix in an unglazed pot; humid Northeast summers invite fungal issues.
note.zh: 用贫瘠的颗粒土和素烧盆；潮湿的夏天容易得真菌病。

idNote.en: Hairy stems + palmate leaves; best guess is cleome.
idNote.zh: 毛茸茸的茎加掌状复叶——我们最接近的猜测是醉蝶花。

light.en: Full sun

water.en: Let soil dry slightly between waterings; drought tolerant once established
water.zh: 两次浇水之间稍微干一干；成株耐旱

catNote.en: ASPCA lists spider flower as non-toxic to cats.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定醉蝶花对猫无毒。

note.en: Self-sows readily and deadheads itself; older varieties have thorny, musky stems.
note.zh: 会自播，还会自己掉残花；老品种茎上有刺、带麝香味。

light.en: Bright indirect; direct sun scorches cream patches
light.zh: 明亮散射光；直射会晒伤奶油色斑

water.en: Water when top 2-3 cm dry; never soggy
water.zh: 表土 2-3 厘米干了再浇；切忌积水

catNote.en: Toxic to cats per ASPCA (insoluble calcium oxalates), listed as Swiss cheese plant
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定龟背竹对猫有毒（不溶性草酸钙）。

note.en: Tissue-culture variegation is stable, but white areas lack chlorophyll so it grows slowly
note.zh: 组培锦化很稳定，但白色部分没有叶绿素，长得慢。

light.en: Low to bright indirect; variegation fades in dim spots
light.zh: 低光到明亮散射光都行；太暗斑纹会变淡

water.en: Let top 2-5 cm dry between waterings
water.zh: 表土干 2-5 厘米再浇

catNote.en: Toxic to cats per ASPCA (insoluble calcium oxalates); causes oral burning and drooling
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定绿萝对猫有毒（不溶性草酸钙）；啃了会口腔灼痛流口水。

note.en: Tolerates missed waterings and low light; one of the most forgiving trailing houseplants
note.zh: 忘浇水、光线差都能忍——最宽容的垂吊植物之一。

idNote.en: Rosettes on stems - some Sedum/Echeveria hybrid.
idNote.zh: 茎上顶着小莲座——某个景天×石莲花的杂交。

light.en: Bright light with direct sun

water.en: Soak-and-dry
water.zh: 干透浇透

catNote.en: Both parents (Sedum, Echeveria) are non-toxic per ASPCA.
catNote.zh: 两个亲本（景天与石莲花）按 ASPCA 都无毒。

note.en: Dropped leaves root wherever they land - free plants.
note.zh: 掉下的叶子落地生根——白捡的新株。

light.en: Bright sun brings out the red

water.en: Soak-and-dry; light in winter
water.zh: 干透浇透；冬天少量

catNote.en: Crassula are toxic to cats per ASPCA.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定青锁龙属对猫有毒。

note.en: More sun means redder pagodas.
note.zh: 太阳越足，宝塔越红。

humidity.en: Average humidity ok; likes a boost, avoid dry drafts
humidity.zh: 普通湿度即可；加湿更好，避免干燥风口

light.en: Bright indirect light; no hot midday sun
light.zh: 明亮散射光；避开正午暴晒

water.en: Water when top 2-3 cm dry; much less in winter
water.zh: 表土 2-3 厘米干了再浇；冬天大减

catNote.en: Toxic to cats (Ficus sap contains ficin/ficusin); irritates mouth, skin, and gut
catNote.zh: 榕属乳汁对猫有毒；刺激口腔、皮肤和肠胃。

note.en: One of the easiest bonsai, but it drops leaves when moved or hit by cold drafts
note.zh: 最好养的盆景之一，但一挪位置或吹冷风就掉叶。

humidity.zh: 高湿度（60%+）；生态瓶里如鱼得水

light.en: Low to medium indirect light; direct sun scorches
light.zh: 低到中等散射光；直射会晒伤

water.en: Keep consistently moist; never let it fully dry
water.zh: 保持湿润；千万别彻底干透

catNote.en: Non-toxic to cats per ASPCA
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定网纹草对猫无毒。

note.en: Famously 'faints' dramatically when thirsty, then revives within hours of watering
note.zh: 渴了会戏剧性地“晕倒”，浇水后几小时内又活过来。

idNote.en: Narrow-leaved rosettes in the handmade pot - dianthus seedlings, perhaps?
idNote.zh: 手作陶盆里的细叶小莲座——说不定是石竹苗？

light.en: Full sun, 6-8 hours

water.en: Keep soil moist; water deeply when top inch dries
water.zh: 保持湿润；表土一寸干了浇透

catNote.en: ASPCA lists basil as non-toxic to cats.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定罗勒对猫无毒。

note.en: Pinch tops and flower buds often for bushier plants; hates temps below 50F.
note.zh: 勤掐尖、摘花苞会更茂盛；低于 10°C 就蔫。

light.en: Bright light; morning sun is ideal
light.zh: 明亮光线；晨光直射最理想

water.en: Water when dry; leaves wrinkle when thirsty
water.zh: 干了再浇；叶子发皱就是渴了

catNote.en: Non-toxic to cats per ASPCA.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定玉缀对猫无毒。

note.en: Extremely brittle - every fallen leaf is a future plant.
note.zh: 极其易碎——每片掉落的叶子都是未来的新株。

light.en: Full sun to part shade

water.en: Medium; drought tolerant once established
water.zh: 中等；成株耐旱

catNote.en: Not listed as toxic by the ASPCA; generally considered cat-safe despite saponins in the roots.
catNote.zh: 不在 ASPCA 有毒名录；虽根含皂苷，一般认为对猫安全。

note.en: Buds inflate like little balloons before popping open; shoots emerge late in spring, so be patient.
note.zh: 花苞先鼓成小气球再“啪”地绽开；春天发芽晚，要有耐心。

humidity.en: Average to dry rooms fine; skip misting to avoid fungus
humidity.zh: 普通到干燥的房间都行；别喷雾以免真菌

light.en: Bright indirect; tolerates a little direct sun
light.zh: 明亮散射光；耐一点直射

water.en: Semi-succulent; let soil nearly dry out between drinks
water.zh: 半多肉性质；土快干透再浇

catNote.en: Non-toxic to cats per ASPCA (Peperomia genus is cat-safe)
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定椒草属对猫无毒。

note.en: Fuzzy leaves are green on top, wine-red beneath; stores water so it forgives forgetfulness
note.zh: 毛茸茸的叶子上绿下酒红；自带储水，健忘也没关系。

idNote.en: Huge fuzzy leaves racing up the balcony window.
idNote.zh: 毛茸茸的大叶子正沿着阳台窗户攀爬。

light.en: Full sun, 6-8 hours

water.en: Thirsty; deep, steady water, big pots dry out fast
water.zh: 很能喝水；大盆也干得快，要深浇勤浇

catNote.en: ASPCA lists squashes (Cucurbita) as non-toxic to cats.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定南瓜类对猫无毒。

note.en: On a porch, hand-pollinate morning flowers with a brush if bees are scarce.
note.zh: 阳台上蜜蜂少，早晨用毛笔帮花授粉。

light.en: Full sun

water.en: Deep but infrequent; dry out fully between waterings
water.zh: 深浇但少浇；两次之间完全干透

catNote.en: Opuntia is non-toxic to cats per ASPCA, but barbed glochid spines can injure paws and mouths.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定仙人掌属对猫无毒，但倒钩芒刺会伤爪子和嘴。

note.en: Young pads (nopales) are edible; handle with tongs since glochids detach at the lightest touch.
note.zh: 嫩掌片（nopales）能吃；芒刺一碰就脱落，要用夹子拿。

humidity.en: Low; dry indoor air is fine
humidity.zh: 低湿度，干燥室内没问题

light.en: Bright light with several hours of direct sun
light.zh: 明亮光线，每天几小时直射

water.en: Soak and dry; water only when soil is fully dry
water.zh: 干透浇透；土完全干了才浇

catNote.en: Toxic per ASPCA; jade plants cause vomiting, depression, and incoordination in cats.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定玉树类对猫有毒；会引起呕吐、萎靡和共济失调。

note.en: Tubular 'Shrek ear' leaves blush red in strong sun; cut water way back in winter.
note.zh: “史莱克耳朵”般的筒叶晒足太阳会泛红；冬天大幅减水。

light.en: Bright indirect light with gentle morning sun
light.zh: 明亮散射光加温和晨光

water.en: Sparse; let soil dry completely, rots easily
water.zh: 少浇；土完全干透再浇，很容易烂

catNote.en: Toxic per ASPCA; causes vomiting and lethargy, so hang it well out of feline reach.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定对猫有毒；会呕吐嗜睡，一定挂在猫够不到的地方。

note.en: Wrinkled pearls signal thirst; shallow roots rot fast, so use a shallow pot and gritty mix.
note.zh: 珠子发皱就是渴了；浅根系易烂，用浅盆和颗粒土。

light.en: Full sun, 6-8 hours

water.en: Deep, consistent watering; uneven moisture causes blossom end rot
water.zh: 深浇且规律；忽干忽湿会得脐腐病

catNote.en: ASPCA lists tomato plant as toxic to cats; solanine in green parts, ripe fruit is safe.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定番茄植株对猫有毒；绿色部分含茄碱，熟果实无害。

note.en: Determinate varieties do best in pots; feed regularly, as containers leach nutrients.
note.zh: 盆栽选有限生长型最合适；容器易流失养分，要常施肥。

light.en: Bright indirect; no hot midday sun
light.zh: 明亮散射光；避开正午烈日

water.en: Weekly when bark and roots dry; never soggy
water.zh: 树皮和根干了再浇，约每周一次；切忌泡水

catNote.en: Phalaenopsis orchids are listed as non-toxic to cats by the ASPCA.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定蝴蝶兰对猫无毒。

note.en: Silvery roots mean it's thirsty; after bloom, cut the spike above a node to coax a rebloom.
note.zh: 根发银白就是渴了；花谢后在节点上方剪掉花剑，能催二次开花。

humidity.en: Average home humidity fine; enjoys occasional misting
humidity.zh: 普通室内湿度即可；偶尔喷雾它很开心

light.en: Low to medium indirect light; no direct sun
light.zh: 低到中等散射光；不要直射

water.en: Keep lightly moist; let top 2-3 cm dry, avoid soggy soil
water.zh: 保持微湿；表土 2-3 厘米干了再浇，忌积水

catNote.en: Non-toxic to cats per ASPCA
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定袖珍椰子对猫无毒。

note.en: A Victorian-era favorite that tolerates low light and neglect; overwatering is its main killer
note.zh: 维多利亚时代的老网红，耐阴耐忽视；浇太多才是它的头号杀手。

light.en: Bright indirect; rotate weekly to keep it symmetrical
light.zh: 明亮散射光；每周转一转才长得对称

water.en: Let top 2-3 cm dry between waterings
water.zh: 表土 2-3 厘米干了再浇

catNote.en: Non-toxic to cats per ASPCA (Pilea genus is cat-safe)
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定冷水花属对猫无毒。

note.en: Produces baby 'pups' around the pot, earning its pass-along 'friendship plant' reputation
note.zh: 会在盆边冒出小崽，因此得名“友谊草”，适合送人。

idNote.en: ID'd from the bronze foliage - flowers will tell.
idNote.zh: 靠古铜色叶子认的——开花后见分晓。

light.en: Part shade; morning sun or filtered light

water.en: Consistently moist; wilts fast if it dries out
water.zh: 保持湿润；一干就蔫

catNote.en: Impatiens are listed as non-toxic to cats by the ASPCA.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定凤仙花对猫无毒。

note.en: Handles more sun than common impatiens and resists downy mildew, but never let it dry out.
note.zh: 比普通凤仙更耐晒、抗霜霉病，但千万别让它干透。

light.en: Full sun to light shade

water.en: Keep soil evenly moist; don't let it bake dry
water.zh: 保持均匀湿润；别晒到干裂

catNote.en: Scarlet sage is listed as non-toxic to cats by the ASPCA.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定一串红对猫无毒。

note.en: A hummingbird magnet; deadhead spent flower spikes for color until frost.
note.zh: 蜂鸟磁铁；勤剪残穗能一直红到霜降。

light.en: Bright indirect light keeps the pink color
light.zh: 明亮散射光才保得住粉色

water.en: Let top of soil dry between waterings
water.zh: 表土干了再浇

catNote.en: Not on ASPCA list, but its sap is known to cause dermatitis and GI upset in cats and dogs.
catNote.zh: 不在 ASPCA 名录，但汁液可能引起猫狗皮炎和肠胃不适。

note.en: Leaves fade from pink to plain green in dim light; pinch tips often to keep it dense.
note.zh: 光线太暗粉色会褪成绿色；勤掐尖才长得密。

idNote.en: Nursery tag: Stonecrop 'Autumn Joy' ('Herbstfreude').
idNote.zh: 苗圃标签：Stonecrop 'Autumn Joy'（'Herbstfreude'）。

humidity.en: Low; average outdoor air is fine
humidity.zh: 低湿度；普通户外空气即可

light.en: Full sun

water.en: Drought tolerant; water only when soil dries
water.zh: 耐旱；土干了才浇

catNote.en: Sedum/stonecrop is listed as non-toxic to cats by the ASPCA.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定景天（八宝）对猫无毒。

note.en: Leave dried flower heads standing for winter interest; overly rich soil makes stems flop.
note.zh: 干枯的花头留着过冬别剪，很有味道；土太肥茎会倒伏。

humidity.zh: 高湿度（60%+）；生态瓶里如鱼得水

light.en: Low to medium indirect light; direct sun scorches
light.zh: 低到中等散射光；直射会晒伤

water.en: Keep consistently moist; never let it fully dry
water.zh: 保持湿润；千万别彻底干透

catNote.en: Non-toxic to cats per ASPCA
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定网纹草对猫无毒。

note.en: Famously 'faints' dramatically when thirsty, then revives within hours of watering
note.zh: 渴了会戏剧性地“晕倒”，浇水后几小时内又活过来。

humidity.zh: 高湿度（60%+）；低于 40% 叶缘会焦

light.en: Bright indirect light; no direct sun

water.en: Keep lightly moist; water when top 2-3 cm dry
water.zh: 保持微湿；表土 2-3 厘米干了再浇

catNote.en: Non-toxic to cats per ASPCA (listed as False Aralia, Dizygotheca elegantissima)
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定孔雀木对猫无毒。

note.en: Drops leaves at drafts, cold, moves, or watering swings; keep conditions steady
note.zh: 吹风、受冷、挪位置、浇水不稳都会掉叶——环境要稳定。

idNote.en: Big bulb + strap leaves + pineapple-shaped bloom.
idNote.zh: 大鳞茎＋带状叶＋菠萝形花穗。

light.en: Full sun, 6+ hours

water.en: Regular in summer; keep nearly dry when dormant
water.zh: 夏天规律浇水；休眠期几乎断水

catNote.en: Not on ASPCA lists; saponin-rich bulbs may cause GI upset, so keep cats away to be safe.
catNote.zh: 不在 ASPCA 名录；鳞茎含皂苷可能引起肠胃不适，防着猫为妙。

note.en: Flower spikes topped with leafy tufts really do look like pineapples; bulbs need a dry winter rest.
note.zh: 花穗顶着叶簇，真像小菠萝；鳞茎冬天需要干燥休眠。

idNote.en: Costa Farms tag: 'Moon Valley Pilea'.
idNote.zh: Costa Farms 标签：“Moon Valley Pilea”。

humidity.en: High (60%+); ideal in terrariums or on pebble trays
humidity.zh: 高湿度（60%+）；适合生态瓶或垫石盘

light.en: Medium to bright indirect light

water.en: Keep evenly moist; let just the surface dry slightly
water.zh: 保持均匀湿润；只让表面稍干

catNote.en: Non-toxic to cats per ASPCA (friendship plant/Pilea listed as safe)
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定冷水花（友谊草）对猫无毒。

note.en: Quilted chartreuse leaves look like moon craters; shrivels fast in dry rooms
note.zh: 绗缝般的黄绿叶像月球环形山；屋里太干很快蔫。

idNote.en: Lives in the crocheted hanger.
idNote.zh: 住在钩针编织的吊篮里。

light.en: Medium to bright indirect light

water.en: Let top 2-3 cm dry; sensitive to overwatering
water.zh: 表土 2-3 厘米干了再浇；怕涝

catNote.en: Non-toxic to cats per ASPCA (listed as Emerald Ripple Peperomia, P. caperata)
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定皱叶椒草对猫无毒。

note.en: Dark rippled leaves with red undersides; sends up quirky rat-tail flower spikes
note.zh: 深色皱叶红背，还会抽出古怪的“鼠尾”花穗。

light.en: Medium to bright indirect; avoid direct midday sun
light.zh: 中等到明亮散射光，避开正午直射

water.en: Let top 2-5 cm dry between waterings
water.zh: 表土干 2-5 厘米再浇

catNote.en: Non-toxic to cats per ASPCA, though cats love chewing it and may get mild GI upset
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定吊兰对猫无毒，但猫爱嚼，吃多了会轻微闹肚子。

note.en: Fluoride in tap water causes brown tips; 'Bonnie' has fun curly leaves and makes babies
note.zh: 自来水里的氟会让叶尖发焦；“Bonnie”卷叶还会生小崽。

humidity.en: High; mist or use a pebble tray

light.en: Bright light with some direct sun for blooms
light.zh: 明亮光线带些直射才开花

water.en: Keep soil evenly moist year-round
water.zh: 全年保持土壤均匀湿润

catNote.en: ASPCA lists chenille (Acalypha) as toxic to cats: drooling, vomiting, diarrhea.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定铁苋（狗尾红）对猫有毒：流涎、呕吐、腹泻。

note.en: Fuzzy red 'cat tail' catkins bloom nearly year-round; pinch off faded ones to encourage more.
note.zh: 毛茸茸的红“猫尾巴”几乎全年开；掐掉谢了的能催新花。

humidity.en: Average home humidity fine; occasional misting appreciated
humidity.zh: 普通室内湿度即可；偶尔喷雾更佳

light.en: Bright indirect; more light deepens the burgundy color
light.zh: 明亮散射光；光越足酒红色越深

water.en: Let top 3-5 cm dry between thorough waterings
water.zh: 表土 3-5 厘米干了再浇透

catNote.en: Toxic to cats per ASPCA (ficin and ficusin in milky sap); GI and skin irritation
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定橡皮树对猫有毒（乳汁）；刺激肠胃和皮肤。

note.en: Wipe the big leaves so they can breathe; milky sap can irritate skin when pruning
note.zh: 常擦大叶子帮它呼吸；修剪时乳汁会刺激皮肤。

idNote.en: Currently hosting two felt birds.
idNote.zh: 目前住着两只毛毡小鸟。

humidity.en: Fine in dry air; wants good air circulation
humidity.zh: 干燥空气没问题；需要好的通风

light.en: Full sun

water.en: Well-drained; drought tolerant once established, water in dry spells
water.zh: 排水要好；成株耐旱，干旱时补水

catNote.en: Not on ASPCA lists; junipers can cause GI upset if nibbled, so treat as unsafe.
catNote.zh: 不在 ASPCA 名录；柏类啃食可能引起肠胃不适，按有毒对待。

note.en: Very slow growing and cold hardy; can overwinter outside in a pot in the Northeast.
note.zh: 长得很慢也很耐寒；可以盆栽在室外过冬。

idNote.en: Store label reads DIANTHUS.
idNote.zh: 商店标签写着 DIANTHUS。

humidity.zh: 低湿度；需要好的空气流通

light.en: Full sun

water.en: Moderate; well-drained soil, avoid soggy crowns
water.zh: 中等；排水好的土，别沤根颈

catNote.en: ASPCA lists pinks/carnations (Dianthus) as toxic to cats: mild GI upset and dermatitis.
catNote.zh: ASPCA 认定石竹（康乃馨类）对猫有毒：轻度肠胃不适和皮炎。

note.en: Flowers smell of cloves; shear plants after the first flush for a repeat bloom.
note.zh: 花有丁香气味；第一波花后修剪一轮还能复花。
